title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The programme in Niger helps to improve access to basic needs and the rights to life, access to food, water, shelter and medical assistance for vulnerable people affected by humanitarian crises in 35 communities in Ouallam, Mirriah and Gouré in Niger. In 2024, GOAL directly reached 40,052 people in various sectors. Thanks to this programme, women's empowerment and decision-making are improved within communities through income-generating activities (VSLA). Access to basic healthcare is improved for people, particularly women and children, in areas where access to sanitation facilities is difficult. The programme supports vulnerable households and people with disabilities affected by multiple shocks. In addition, the programme provides access to smart farming techniques adapted to climate change in rural communities to improve diversification and consumption of a variety of micronutrient-rich foods.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2: People Have Resilient Health. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: GOAL focuses on health system strengthening with the objective of increasing the number and percentage of health facilities providing quality health services (including nutrition services and WASH facilities), so that health and well-being can improve. Under the RMNCHN component, GOAL’s intervention primarily aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women and adolescent girls, infants and children, and will also build the resilience of the health system.
